{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tapani Arts and Sports Complex''' was the premier sport and entertainment venue in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was located on the planet [[Vycinyth]] and contained several huge stadiums and arenas that could accommodate activities such as [[Shockboxing/Legends|shockboxing]], [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] and [[Cracian thumper]] racing.<ref name="LOTE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
